title: VM repo bootstrap and secret-hygiene proof
summary: Clone the repo to the VM, create .env.local from .env.example, prove that secrets cannot reach git, install pre-commit, and record tool versions. Evidence is redacted output only.

acceptance_tests.test: ~/projects/gigantic-journeys is a clone of the GitHub repo; .env.local exists with PLACEHOLDER values; `git check-ignore -v .env.local` shows the .gitignore rule; `git ls-files | grep -c '^\.env'` is 1 (.env.example only).
`pre-commit install` done; `pre-commit run --all-files` is green (log excerpt).
Unity, Node, Python, git, and Supabase CLI versions on the VM are recorded; Node ≥ 22, Python ≥ 3.11.
No secret value, hostname of a private service, or account email appears in the PR.
